canary.purpose: Limited rollout validation using isolated test data

production.purpose: Live player experience and production data

persistence.backup_strategy: Keep versioned backups and verify a restore rehearsal before destructive migrations.
persistence.recovery_runbook: Quarantine the affected profile, preserve the last known good backup, and require owner approval before restoring player state.

migrations.validation_scenario: Run the migration twice against an isolated fixture and compare the resulting version-two profile.
migrations.rollback_plan: Restore the captured version-one fixture and confirm no production profile was modified.

products.grant_definition: Grant exactly the configured fixed currency amount once per verified receipt.

kill_switch.activation_procedure: Disable the named feature flag, confirm server acknowledgement, and record the change.

rollout.rollback_plan: Stop promotion, disable the feature flag, restore the last compatible release, and follow the approved data recovery procedure. Never roll back by overwriting newer player data.

alerts: Alert on sustained player data save failures above the agreed baseline.
Alert on purchase receipt processing errors and unexpected grant mismatches.
Alert on abnormal remote rejection or server error rates.
observability.incident_runbook: Triage impact, preserve evidence, contain the affected feature, notify the owner, roll back safely, and document recovery and follow-up actions.
